blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol — The body of a barangay councilor from Loay town, Bohol was found in the waters off Larena, Siquijor. The local official went missing after falling from his motorized boat while fishing more than a week ago. Loay Mayor Hilario Ayuban Jr. and other local government representatives traveled to Larena, Siquijor on Wednesday morning, November 18, to retrieve the remains of Barangay Yanangan Councilor Andres Patayon and bring them back to Loay.
